Most talents are passive. They change your numbers or grant a standing benefit, and they are always on; a few are activated talents, and their card's Action field says so. Abilities are active. Spells, weapon maneuvers, and class powers must be activated to use. Both use the card format below.

Every card lists its Disciplines, Action, Range, and Keywords. A card is bought once, at one tier, for one price, and it never changes: Novice 2 DP, Adept 4 DP, Master 8 DP. Active cards (abilities, spells, and weapon maneuvers) resolve on a roll, and a Novice active card prints its Weak, Standard, and Strong outcomes. Passive cards are always on, and a Novice passive card prints a single effect. An Adept or Master card is its own card with its own name and its own effect; you never buy one card and grow it into another. The level gate is the only gate: Novice at level 1, Adept at level 3, Master at level 7, plus the card's own Discipline rank. See @sec-chapter-disciplines for tier, Discipline, and cost rules. See @sec-chapter-magic-system for casting rules.

Bonuses from different talents stack. The same talent cannot be taken more than once.

#pagebreak()

== Talents

The talents below are general. Any class may take any of them, though a talent that lists a Discipline requirement is gated by it like any other card. A talent may also require a kit, and a talent that grants kit grants one kit point and nothing else.

=== Fortune's Favor (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Reaction · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Reroll

*Novice:* Once per session, reroll one natural 1, 2, or 3.

=== Turn the Bones (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Reaction · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Reroll

*Effect:* Once per scene, reroll any one die.

=== Combat Reflexes (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Reaction

*Novice:* You gain one extra Reaction per round.

=== Tough (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* HP

*Novice:* +2 maximum HP.

=== Iron Skin (Talent)
*Disciplines:* 1 Armor · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* DR

*Novice:* +2 DR, in addition to your armor's DR.

=== Weapon Focus (Talent)
*Disciplines:* 1 chosen weapon Discipline · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Damage

*Novice:* Boon on attack rolls with weapons of the chosen weapon Discipline.

=== Skill Focus (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Skill

*Novice:* +1 to one skill you choose.

=== Iron Will (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Check

*Novice:* Boon on checks against fear and charm.

=== Guarding Stance (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* DR, Defend

*Novice:* When you take the Defend maneuver, adjacent allies gain +2 DR until the start of your next turn.

=== Refuse to Fall (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Reaction · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* HP

*Novice:* When you drop to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP and gain temporary HP equal to twice your level. Once per session.

=== Death Blow (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Critical, Damage

*Novice:* On a Critical, the attack deals +1 damage tier (one row up on the damage budget, maximum 21).

=== Arcane Reservoir (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Spell

*Novice:* Once per session, cast a Master spell you know a second time.

=== Miracle Worker (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Reaction · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* Healing

*Novice:* Once per session, when an ally within 30 ft drops to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP and regain half their maximum HP.

=== Arcane Sensitivity (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Spell

*Novice:* Boon on spell rolls for one Discipline you choose.

=== The Full Ledger (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Spell

*Effect:* Once per scene, cast any spell you know a second time.

=== Spell Storm (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Spell, Area

*Novice:* Once per session, a single-target spell you cast also hits all other targets you choose within 15 ft of the original target; roll once and apply that result to every target, the original included.

=== Linguist (Talent)
*Disciplines:* 1 Lore · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Language

*Novice:* You read and speak one additional language.

=== Battlefield Assessment (Talent)
*Disciplines:* 1 Tactics · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Sight · *Keywords:* Tactics

*Novice:* Once per scene, learn the relative strength of every enemy in sight and their highest attribute.

=== Quick Study (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Free · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Skill

*Novice:* Once per session, use a skill you do not have at Novice (+1) for one check.

=== Chaotic Insight (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Reaction · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Reroll

*Novice:* Once per session, reroll any roll you just made, using fresh dice.

=== Rally the Troops (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Maneuver · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* Frightened

*Novice:* Once per session, all allies within 30 ft remove Frightened or Dazed and gain a Boon on their next roll.

=== Dangerous Gambit (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Damage

*Novice:* Once per scene, when you roll 14 or higher, increase the damage tier of the result by one.

=== Trap Sense (Talent)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Passive · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Boon, Traps

*Novice:* Boon on checks to detect and disarm traps, and you cannot be surprised by a trap.

== Basic Attacks

These four cards are the attacks every character can make, no Discipline required. They are the floor. Weapon Disciplines gate access to stronger cards, not higher damage. See @sec-chapter-combat for attack and damage rules.

*Range.* A range written as two numbers, such as *60/120 ft*, is two bands. Within the first number you attack normally. Between the first number and the second you attack at a *Bane*. Beyond the second number the target is out of reach, and you cannot attack it at all. A single number, such as *30 ft*, is one band: you attack normally inside it and cannot reach past it.

=== Basic Melee (Basic Attack)
*Disciplines:* None · *Kit:* weapon:one-hand · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Damage

*Weak:* 1 + Brawn damage (Agility with a Finesse weapon).

*Standard:* 2 + Brawn damage (Agility with a Finesse weapon).

*Strong:* 3 + Brawn damage (Agility with a Finesse weapon).

=== Basic Archery (Basic Attack)
*Disciplines:* None · *Kit:* weapon:ranged · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 60/120 ft · *Keywords:* Damage

*Weak:* 1 damage.

*Standard:* 2 damage.

*Strong:* 3 damage.

=== Basic Thrown (Basic Attack)
*Disciplines:* None · *Kit:* weapon:ranged · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 20/60 ft · *Keywords:* Damage

*Weak:* 1 damage.

*Standard:* 2 damage.

*Strong:* 3 damage.

=== Basic Unarmed (Basic Attack)
*Disciplines:* None · *Kit:* weapon:unarmed · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Damage

*Weak:* 1 + Brawn damage.

*Standard:* 1 + Brawn damage.

*Strong:* 2 + Brawn damage.

== Weapon Maneuvers

Maneuvers spend your Action, Reaction, or Maneuver as listed on each card. Each is gated by Disciplines: most by a weapon Discipline, though Shield Slam requires Armor and Renewal requires Protection. See @sec-chapter-combat for Action, Maneuver, and Reaction rules.

A maneuver's Weak/Standard/Strong block is that card's Novice effect, on the Novice budget row (4/6/8). The Adept and Master members of the family are separate cards with their own rows and their own names. Your weapon contributes no damage of its own: the card carries the numbers, exactly as it does for any other ability. See @sec-chapter-equipment

=== Riposte (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 2 Blades · *Action:* Reaction · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Counterattack

*Weak:* When an enemy deals Weak damage to you, counterattack for 2.

*Standard:* When an enemy deals Weak damage to you, counterattack for 4.

*Strong:* When an enemy deals Weak damage to you, counterattack for 6.

=== Power Strike (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 2 Blades · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Damage

*Weak:* +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack.

*Standard:* +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack.

*Strong:* +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack.

=== Cyclone (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 3 Blades · *Kit:* weapon:two-hand · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Area

*Weak:* Hit all adjacent enemies for 2 damage.

*Standard:* Hit all adjacent enemies for 4 damage.

*Strong:* Hit all adjacent enemies for 6 damage.

=== Cleave (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 2 Axes · *Kit:* weapon:one-hand · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Chain

*Weak:* Hit one target. If it drops to 0 HP, hit an adjacent enemy for the same damage.

*Standard:* Hit one target. If it drops to 0 HP, hit an adjacent enemy for the same damage.

*Strong:* Hit one target. If it drops to 0 HP, hit an adjacent enemy for the same damage.

=== Pinpoint Strike (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 1 Blades · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Piercing, Damage

*Weak:* +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack, and Piercing 1.

*Standard:* +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack, and Piercing 2.

*Strong:* +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack, and Piercing 3.

=== Shield Slam (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 2 Armor · *Kit:* shield · *Action:* Maneuver · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Prone, Push

*Weak:* Deal 2 damage and Push 5 ft.

*Standard:* Deal 4 damage and Push 5 ft.

*Strong:* Deal 6 damage and Push 5 ft; the target is Prone.

=== Parry (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 2 Blades · *Action:* Reaction · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* DR, Counterattack

*Weak:* +1 DR against one attack.

*Standard:* +2 DR against one attack.

*Strong:* +3 DR against one attack and counterattack for 2 damage.

=== Disarm (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 2 Blades · *Action:* Maneuver · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Bane

*Weak:* The target keeps its grip.

*Standard:* The target's next attack with that weapon is at Bane.

*Strong:* The target drops the weapon.

=== Trip (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 2 Polearms · *Action:* Maneuver · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Prone

*Weak:* The target is Prone.

*Standard:* The target is Prone and loses its Maneuver.

*Strong:* The target is Prone and loses its Action.

=== Charge (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 2 Heavy Weapon · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Movement, Damage

*Weak:* Move up to your Speed and make one attack at +1 damage tier.

*Standard:* Move up to your Speed and make one attack at +1 damage tier.

*Strong:* Move up to your Speed and make one attack at +1 damage tier.

=== Brace (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 2 Polearms · *Action:* Reaction · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* DR

*Weak:* +2 DR against a charge (see Charge Attack in the Equipment chapter); the attacker takes 2 damage.

*Standard:* +2 DR against a charge; the attacker takes 4 damage.

*Strong:* +2 DR against a charge; the attacker takes 6 damage.

=== Dual Strike (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 1 Blades · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Two attacks

*Weak:* Two attacks, each dealing 1 damage (2 total).

*Standard:* Two attacks, each dealing 2 damage (4 total).

*Strong:* Two attacks, each dealing 3 damage (6 total).

=== Crushing Blow (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 2 Heavy Weapon · *Kit:* weapon:two-hand · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Damage, Prone

*Weak:* +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack.

*Standard:* +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack.

*Strong:* +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack; the target is Prone.

=== Executioner's Cut (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 2 Axes · *Kit:* weapon:two-hand · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Damage, Wounded

*Weak:* +1 damage tier against a wounded target.

*Standard:* +1 damage tier against a wounded target.

*Strong:* +1 damage tier against a wounded target.

=== Throw (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 1 Archery · *Kit:* weapon:ranged · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* Ranged

*Weak:* Throw a weapon up to 30 ft at +1 damage tier.

*Standard:* Throw a weapon up to 30 ft at +1 damage tier.

*Strong:* Throw a weapon up to 30 ft at +1 damage tier.

=== Breakthrough (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 2 Heavy Weapon · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Melee · *Keywords:* Movement, Prone

*Weak:* Move through one enemy's space.

*Standard:* Move through one enemy's space.

*Strong:* Move through one enemy's space; the target is Prone.

=== Renewal (Weapon Maneuver)
*Disciplines:* 1 Protection · *Action:* Maneuver · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Healing

*Weak:* Regain 2 HP.

*Standard:* Regain 4 HP.

*Strong:* Regain 6 HP.
